Loss report: gitlab -> woodpecker
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (hidden, include) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.api (Woodpecker starts API pipelines as manual events)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.pipeline_done (the source runs on the events pipeline, parent_pipeline when its file names no trigger; Woodpecker has no event for them)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.resource (the source runs on the events external, chat when its file names no trigger; Woodpecker has no event for them)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (coverage) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.retry (Woodpecker has no retry key; restarts are manual)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/common job.retry (Woodpecker has no retry key; restarts are manual)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/prod ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (extends, interruptible, resource_group) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/prod job.retry (Woodpecker has no retry key; restarts are manual)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.env: copied into the environment of every step (a step variable of the same name wins)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Woodpecker runs commands through /bin/sh -e of the image, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/common/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Woodpecker runs commands through /bin/sh -e of the image, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/prod/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Woodpecker runs commands through /bin/sh -e of the image, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
